'''Hunta.Waya I made a dark deal with Padme''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list Hunta.Waya posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-16560">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16560 I made a dark deal with Padme], DeckTech (John "Hunta.Waya" Smith, 7 June 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16560/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16560/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' Hunta.Waya
* '''Published:''' 7 June 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''I made a dark deal with Padme''

== Original post ==

'''I made a dark deal with Padme'''
* '''Author:''' John "Hunta.Waya" Smith
* '''Published:''' June 7, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 1.5
* '''Description:''' I sabatoged Sebulbas podracer, and now she is gonna give me head.

=== Strategy ===

The purpose of this website is to rate the deck, not the playa.  I don't have to tell you how I play this game, so rate the deck....JUST THE DECK.
